message: Hey Sandy, how was your day at the beach?
It was perfect! The weather couldn’t have been better.
Sounds great! Did you manage to catch the sunset?
The beach was amazing today. You have to see the sunset photos I took!
Sandy, did you make it back in time for dinner?
Just barely! Traffic was a bit crazy, but it was worth it.
Glad to hear it. Did you enjoy the view?
The beach was amazing today. You have to see the sunset photos I took!
